types.name: Data
types.description: Information, intelligence, codes, manifests, navigation charts, communications.

standing_interest.reason: The Empire treats unauthorized possession of Imperial data as a capital offense. Recovery and source identification are both priorities.
Information is Black Sun's core product. Any significant data cache has trade or leverage value.
Data is leverage. The Hutts want anything that gives them an advantage over trading partners or rivals.

types.name: Artifact
types.description: Force-related objects, ancient items, relics of extinct civilizations, kyber crystals, holocrons.

standing_interest.reason: Standing ISB orders to secure Force artifacts. Local garrison may not know why — orders come from above their clearance.
Force artifacts are their primary mission objective. They will kill for them without hesitation.
No intrinsic interest. Value only as a commodity — something to sell to the highest bidder.
Leverage and trade value. Black Sun doesn't understand Force artifacts but knows they're worth something to the right buyer.

types.name: Weapon
types.description: Conventional or exotic armament, prototype weapons, weapons of mass destruction, military hardware.

standing_interest.reason: Unauthorized weapons — especially prototypes or military hardware — are an immediate security concern.
Weapons are a commodity. The Hutts move arms as readily as spice.
Arms trade is a Black Sun revenue stream. A unique weapon has both use and sale value.

types.name: Resource
types.description: Physical commodities — spice, fuel, rare materials, medical supplies, food in quantity.

standing_interest.reason: The Hutts control resource flow through their space. Anything moving without their cut is a problem.
Commodities can be moved, taxed, or seized. Black Sun takes a percentage of significant resource flows.
Only relevant if the resource is on a controlled list — spice, weapons-grade materials — or if it belongs to the Empire.

types.name: Person
types.description: Someone who needs moving, protecting, rescuing, or capturing. A defector, a witness, a fugitive, a specialist.

standing_interest.reason: Defectors, wanted criminals, Force-sensitives — the Empire maintains active target lists. A person with a bounty or a file is a priority.
People have bounty value. The Hutts will sell them to whoever pays the most.
Leverage, ransom, or sale. A person who knows something is worth more alive.
Only relevant if the person is Force-sensitive. Force-sensitives are recruitment targets — the Knights collect, they don't rescue.

types.name: Leverage
types.description: Blackmail material, legal documents, proof of criminal activity, incriminating evidence, contracts.

standing_interest.reason: Leverage is Black Sun's native currency. Any blackmail material or incriminating evidence has immediate value.
Hutts run on leverage. Documents that give power over rivals, clients, or the Empire are worth acquiring.
ISB uses leverage routinely. Evidence against Imperial officers or Hutt leadership is a tool, not just a threat.

types.name: Technology
types.description: Prototype tech, stolen proprietary systems, advanced droids, experimental equipment.

standing_interest.reason: Stolen Imperial technology is recovered. Non-Imperial prototype technology is acquired. Both are security priorities.
Technology has sale value to the right buyer. Black Sun brokers these transactions.
Relevant only if the technology has direct commercial application — shipping, mining, weapons.

origins.name: Imperial
origins.description: Stolen from or belonging to the Empire.

escalation.effect: Escalates Imperial interest to HIGH regardless of type. This is their property. Recovery is a standing order.

origins.name: Criminal
origins.description: From criminal underworld — a syndicate, a cartel, an independent operation.

escalation.effect: If the criminal origin is Hutt-adjacent, escalates Hutt interest. Something taken from the Hutt network belongs to the Hutts.
If the criminal origin is Black Sun-adjacent, escalates their interest immediately. They want their property back.

origins.name: Force
origins.description: Force tradition origin — Jedi, Sith, ancient order, or unknown Force tradition.

escalation.effect: Triggers Inquisitorius involvement if sensitivity reaches 'known'. ISB standing orders cover Force-origin objects.
Escalates Knights of Ren interest to HIGH regardless of type. Force origin is their primary filter.

origins.name: Civilian
origins.description: Civilian or corporate origin — a business, an individual, a non-faction entity.

origins.name: Ancient
origins.description: Predates current factions — pre-Republic, extinct civilization, unknown manufacture.

escalation.effect: Ancient objects frequently have Force significance. Escalates Knights of Ren interest to HIGH.
Ancient artifacts of unknown origin trigger ISB standing orders for containment.

sensitivities.name: Unknown
sensitivities.description: Only the players know they have it. No faction is aware yet.

sensitivities.name: Rumored
sensitivities.description: Word is starting to spread. Information brokers are hearing things.

galaxy_alert.effect: Black Sun intelligence networks pick up rumors faster than anyone. They're aware something exists but not what.

sensitivities.name: Known
sensitivities.description: Multiple factions are aware. Active intelligence operations are underway.

galaxy_alert.effect: Full awareness. Active operation to acquire or monitor.
If McGuffin is Imperial origin or Force origin, a response has been dispatched. Clock is running.

sensitivities.name: Contested
sensitivities.description: Active competition underway. Multiple factions are moving simultaneously.

galaxy_alert.effect: Active pursuit. Garrison on planet is on alert.
The Hutts have entered the bidding or the hunt, depending on the McGuffin type.

galaxy_faction_interest.dispatch_trigger: If McGuffin is Imperial origin at 'known' sensitivity OR Force origin at 'known' sensitivity — an off-planet response has been dispatched.
galaxy_faction_interest.dispatch_clock: 1-3 sessions depending on Imperial intelligence reach in this region.
galaxy_faction_interest.dispatch_type: Inquisitor (Force origin) or ISB investigation team (Imperial origin)

galaxy_faction_interest.dispatch_trigger: If McGuffin is Force origin or Ancient origin at any sensitivity above 'unknown' — a Knight has been dispatched or is already present.
galaxy_faction_interest.dispatch_clock: Unknown. They may already be here.
